For every such actual zero, one c_rho>0 bounds the global off-integer-lattice sinc-squared weighted canonical negative mass below by c_rho sqrt(a^2+b^2), for all real a,b.
No nonzero such real combination is off-lattice nonnegative.
For an actual strip zero, Re rho != 1/2 implies Im kappa !=0, using the proved real-strip zeta nonvanishing; no separate ordinate assumption.
If kappa is real, conjugation gives the same actual normalized zeroth-jet measure (identity or reflection), the canonical imaginary distribution is zero, and the pair is dependent.
